entities.name: The Handshake
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Originally a gesture proving you carried no weapon — grasping the right (sword) hand showed peaceful intent. Roman reliefs show handshakes sealing treaties and business deals. The custom spread with the Roman Empire and became the default Western greeting.
